actions.name: find_invoice
actions.description: Search for an invoice by its number in QuickBooks.

actions.name: find_customer
actions.description: Search for a customer by display name in QuickBooks.

actions.name: find_payment
actions.description: Finds an existing payment in QuickBooks.

actions.name: create_expense
actions.description: Creates an expense transaction (purchase) in QuickBooks.

actions.name: create_bill
actions.description: Creates a bill (accounts payable) in QuickBooks.

actions.name: find_vendor
actions.description: Search for a vendor in QuickBooks by display name, email address, or account number.

actions.name: find_account
actions.description: List or search the chart of accounts to get an account Id (e.g. an expense account for a bill).

actions.name: record_payment
actions.description: Records a customer payment in QuickBooks, optionally applying it to invoices.

actions.name: record_bill_payment
actions.description: Pays one or more vendor bills in QuickBooks, in full or in part, by check or credit card.

actions.name: read_aging_report
actions.description: Reads an accounts receivable or accounts payable aging report from QuickBooks.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
